transmission.notes: The official BMW 09/2021 and 07/2024 i4 sheets list a single-speed transmission with fixed ratio for the i4 M50. The repo maps that to the canonical SS1 single-speed EV transmission; the fixed reduction is stored as the axle ratio and an EV has no top gear.
transmission.name: Single-speed fixed gear (EV)

final_drive_rear.notes: The official BMW 09/2021 and 07/2024 i4 sheets both list 9.374 as the rear electric-motor gear ratio for the i4 M50.

final_drive_front.notes: The official BMW 09/2021 and 07/2024 i4 sheets both list 8.774 as the front electric-motor gear ratio for the i4 M50.

default.notes: The official BMW 09/2021 and 07/2024 i4 sheets list 245/45 R18 front and 255/45 R18 rear as the standard tyres for the i4 M50.

options.name: Standard 18" staggered
options.notes: The official BMW 09/2021 and 07/2024 i4 sheets list 245/45 R18 front and 255/45 R18 rear as the standard tyres for the i4 M50.

verification_notes.note: The official BMW 09/2021 i4 specifications and the German technical data valid from July 2024 agree for the i4 M50: one motor per axle, front gear ratio 8.774, rear 9.374, and 245/45 R18 front / 255/45 R18 rear tyres. The earlier 8.698 front and rear values had no source and are replaced; the old unresolved claims of 9.053 or 9.744 / 8.776 do not match either sheet.
BMW's summer 2025 model-update article states that the i4 M60 xDrive replaces the i4 M50 from July 2025, so the M50 row ends with 2025.
